# Runtime source provenance adapter

Contract ID: `GNSS118-CODE-ONLY-PROVENANCE-V1`.

This is a new code-only source inventory, not the historical E0 archive.
Legacy filenames are retained because the existing runtime interface reads them.
The original E0 research inventory, manuscripts, run outputs and reports remain local.
The runtime algorithm and scientific configuration are unchanged. The manifest
lists only the Python and scientific configuration files shipped in this core.
External observations, ephemerides and the DLL must be supplied through configuration.
